name: Piste karting Selongey
evidence: OSM maps a 518 m track named 'Piste karting Selongey' (raceway way tagged access=no) in farmland/forest outside Selongey, sourced from the 2012 cadastre; no web presence of any karting venue or club in Selongey was found.

The OSM way is itself tagged disused=yes and lies in the town centre of Souppes-sur-Loing next to a campsite, sports ground and the river; no current karting venue in Souppes was found online (a directory counts a karting facility in the commune but without any name).
299 m raceway in farmland by the Moine river near La Romagne with no named facility nearby in OSM; web searches found no karting venue in La Romagne or Sèvremoine.

298 m raceway in an urban area of Tours near Parc de Sainte-Radegonde, schools and a community centre; the known Tours-area kart venues are in Joué-lès-Tours and La Ville-aux-Dames, and nothing was found at this spot.

Tiny 154 m single-lane loop on the Trouville seafront by Place Foch, about 160 m from Les Trouvillaises, which rents children's pedal karts; no motor kart venue exists in Trouville (the nearest is Pont-l'Évêque), so this is most likely a children's pedal-kart circuit. Downgraded to uncertain: inferred from location only.
Small area tagged leisure=pitch + sport=karting next to a sports centre and football pitch in Coudekerque-Village; no karting club or venue in Téteghem-Coudekerque-Village was found online.

name: XtremCenter Valence
evidence: The node sits 30 m from the OSM building 'Xtrem Valence' (amusement arcade, sport=motor) in the ZA les Mourettes; directory listings describe XtremCenter, 126 route de Beauvallon, Valence, as an indoor karting track (opened 2002) with bowling and laser game. No official website found. Rental left unverified: source is a directory listing.
609 m raceway next to the village football and tennis pitches of Valprivas, imported from the French sports-equipment census (2021); no karting venue or club in Valprivas was found online.

The track lies inside the 5-star campsite Domaine La Yole (Vendres/Valras-Plage), so it is at most a guest/children's attraction; campsite listings mention water park, mini-golf and farm but no karting. Sun Karting (Sérignan) is 2.25 km away and is a separate venue.

Two small leisure=track karting ways plus a motor raceway node in a rural spot of Villefranque next to a private swimming pool, suggesting a private property; no karting venue in Villefranque was found online (nearest public track is Karting Côte Basque in Briscous).
Untagged-except-sport=karting feature in the rural village of Véraza with no named facility nearby; no karting venue or club in Véraza was found (nearest known venue is Win'Kart, Carcassonne).

name: MES77 RC track (Stade Dominique Rocheteau)
evidence: The area lies in the Complexe sportif Dominique Rocheteau in Émerainville, where the model-car club MES77 runs an electric radio-controlled car track (DTM and 1/12 classes) built on a former skate area; it is an RC car track, not a kart track.

Three adjoining raceway ways (main 499 m) near the Golf des Rochers Sévigné at Étrelles; no karting venue or club in Étrelles or Vitré was found online (Ille-et-Vilaine venues listed are Lohéac, La Mézière, Melesse, Saint-Méloir).

name: Kartodromo di Acerra
evidence: OSM node carries alt_name 'Kartodromo di Acerra' with two karting raceway ways and construction land beside it, but no web source for a kart track in Acerra was found; the nearest found venue, Kartodromo Napoli, is in Afragola about 6 km away.

Pitch tagged sport=karting at Valle San Bartolomeo; the only web trace is a 2009 Minimoto forum thread about the Valle S. Bartolomeo track reopening (minimoto, pit bike and supermoto), so it may be a minimoto track and its current status is unknown.

Sports-centre area tagged karting next to a motor raceway and village pitches at Madonna della Carità, Ancarano; no kart venue in Ancarano was found online (Kartodromo Val Vibrata/Mad Racing is about 5 km away and already in the dataset).

Short 188 m asphalt loop among private villas with swimming pools and a residential garden near Relais Sant'Agostino outside Andria, which suggests a private track; no kart venue at this location was found online.
222 m karting raceway next to an unnamed motor raceway area between Angri and Sant'Antonio Abate; no kart venue at this location was found online.
560 m racetrack plus a second karting raceway near Cecchina (Ariccia) next to a car-repair shop and a private pool; two web searches found no kart venue in Cecchina, Ariccia or Albano.
Isolated 176 m raceway at Cardillo (Avigliano) with nothing tagged around it; no kart venue in Avigliano was found online.

Sports-centre area tagged karting next to industrial land between Banzi and Palazzo San Gervasio; no kart venue there was found online (the similarly named Kartodromo Palazzo is in Trecchina, far away).
177 m one-way loop in the Stanic industrial/commercial area of Bari, about 0.9 km from Kartodromo Barimax (already in the dataset); no separate kart venue at this spot was found online.
Track area tagged karting next to another unnamed track in Bianco (province of Reggio Calabria); no kart venue in Bianco was found online.
Track tagged karting beside the football and tennis pitches of Borgetto; no kart venue in Borgetto was found (Pista del Lago is in Contrada Baronia, Partinico, near Lago Poma, several km away).
641 m karting raceway plus a second raceway beside a retail/commercial area (Eurospar, Unieuro) in Botricello; two web searches found no kart venue in Botricello.
Sports-centre area with a 266 m karting raceway next to the Natalino Indrigo baseball/softball centre in Bovisio Masciago; two web searches found no kart, minimoto or model-car track here.
578 m raceway beside the football pitches of Centro Sportivo Comunale 'Gino Pederzini' between two industrial zones in Calderara di Reno; two web searches found no kart track in Calderara di Reno.

The OSM way itself is tagged disused=yes (asphalt kart loop among hotels near Park Camper Kennedy, Lido di Camaiore); no current kart venue at Lido di Camaiore was found online, so it is probably a closed seaside track.

Asphalt kart area at Museddu, Cardedu, with nothing else tagged nearby; Trip.com lists a 'Pista Kart I Ginepri' as a Cardedu attraction, but no source confirms its position, so it cannot be tied to this spot.

877 m raceway next to the Laghi Nabi resort (park, glamping, hotel) at Baia Verde; Laghi Nabi listings mention water sports but no karting. 'Pista Italia Kart' (already in the dataset, OSM way/249504927) is a separate track about 0.6 km away, so this one remains unidentified.

Sports-centre area with two karting raceways (928 m) at Castel di Sangro; hotel portals list a 'kart' landmark in Castel di Sangro (about 1.4 km from Hotel Il Tiglio), but no name, operator or rental information was found.
Small sports-centre area with a 175 m asphalt kart raceway next to the Campo Comunale and private gardens in Castrocielo; no kart venue in Castrocielo was found online.
Isolated 284 m raceway near the rural hamlet of Pascarosa (Ceglie Messapica) with nothing tagged nearby; two web searches found no kart venue there.

Pitch tagged karting immediately beside the Circuito Tazio Nuvolari (Cervesina) grandstand; the circuit's website lists no kart track, only a 480 m 'Nivolino' track homologated by the motorcycle federation (FMI) for minor-speed training, which may be what this is.
Bare node tagged leisure=track + sport=karting in Cerveteri with no surrounding tagged features; no kart venue in Cerveteri was found online.
Raceway at Cetraro Marina near the 'Phoenix' sports hall and car workshops; no kart venue in Cetraro was found online.
481 m raceway at Ca' Lino (Chioggia) next to the 'Al Ranch' restaurant with an equestrian pitch and pool; no kart venue at Ca' Lino or Sottomarina was found online.

Small raceway in the resort centre of Lido degli Scacchi right beside the seasonal children's theme park 'Scaccolandia' and beach establishments, suggesting a summer mini-kart attraction; no source confirms it. Circuito di Pomposa (already in the dataset) is 1.8 km away.

name: Circuito la Scintilla
evidence: OSM names the surrounding sports centre 'Circuito la Scintilla' and maps karting, motor and motocross raceways there, but no web source for it exists; nearby Rieti venues found (Rambo Racing on SS4, Kartodromo La Mola) could not be tied to this location.
